ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the figure “profile made along the 20° meridian.” <image1> According to the diagram, G Mountain was formed by the collision of which two plates?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The diagram is a topographic profile made along the 20° meridian; the vertical axis represents elevation, and the horizontal axis represents the latitude direction. In the figure, point G is a very high peak, located north of about 40°N and close to the latitude belt of southern Europe. Then reason: 20°E and about 40°—50°N correspond to the Alpine—Mediterranean tectonic belt in southern Europe. The mountain systems of this tectonic belt were mainly formed by the African Plate moving northward and colliding and compressing with the Eurasian Plate, so G Mountain was formed by the collision of the Eurasian Plate and the African Plate.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：横轴是沿20°经线的纬度剖面，G为约40°N以北的高山峰。再推理：把20°E、约40°–50°N定位到欧洲南部的阿尔卑斯—地中海构造带；该带属于非洲板块向北与亚欧板块碰撞挤压形成的山系，因此答案为亚欧板块与非洲板块。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图示为沿20°经线所作的地形剖面，纵轴表示海拔高度，横轴表示纬度方向。图中G处是一个海拔很高的尖峰，位置在约40°N以北、接近欧洲南部纬度带。再推理：20°E、约40°—50°N对应欧洲南部的阿尔卑斯—地中海构造带。该构造带的山系主要由非洲板块向北与亚欧板块碰撞挤压形成，因此G山是由亚欧板块和非洲板块碰撞形成的。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses the coordinate position of G on the 20°E meridian as the main clue, then maps that location to a known tectonic boundary; distinct from methods that first identify the named mountain belt by regional landform sequence.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the diagram as a north-south topographic profile along 20°E. Locate G as the tallest peak just north of the 40°N tick, roughly in southern/central Europe near the Mediterranean sector.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question statement that asks specifically for the two plates whose collision formed mountain G, and that the image is a profile along 20° longitude.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Know that around 40°–50°N on the 20°E meridian lies the Alpine-Dinaric/Alpide mountain belt, which was produced by convergence/collision of the African Plate with the Eurasian Plate.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：剖面沿20°E由南向北穿过非洲、地中海附近低地/海域，再到北侧的显著高山G。再推理：20°E剖面北非与欧洲之间的高山应属于地中海—阿尔卑斯构造带；根据板块构造，地中海北缘山脉由非洲板块向北俯冲/碰撞亚欧板块形成，所以G山对应亚欧板块与非洲板块碰撞。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中为沿20°E经线所作的地形剖面，横轴表示纬度，由南向北经过非洲、赤道附近、地中海附近，再到北侧欧洲方向；纵轴为海拔。剖面右侧北纬约40°—60°附近有一座明显高大的山峰，标注为G。推理：20°E剖面上位于北非与欧洲之间、地中海北侧附近的高山属于地中海—阿尔卑斯构造带。该构造带的形成与非洲板块向北运动并同亚欧板块碰撞、挤压有关。因此，G山是亚欧板块与非洲板块碰撞形成的。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the profile from lower/southern latitudes through the equator to northern latitudes; notice a low area near the Mediterranean-latitude zone and then the prominent G mountain on the north side, indicating the major mountain belt at the Africa-Europe contact zone.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Know the global plate-boundary rule that young high fold mountains near the Mediterranean are caused by continental collision/convergence, specifically the African Plate colliding with the Eurasian Plate.
